public Decimal calculate(
  Decimal amount,
  Boolean isDomesticTransaction
)

Calculate the Stripe service fees for a given USD amount

Parameters:
    amount – Decimal: amount in USD to calculate the service fees for
    isDomesticTransaction – Boolean: if true then domestic fees apply, otherwise international fees apply

Returns:
    [Decimal] Stripe fees in USD for the transaction

public Decimal calculate(
  Decimal amount,
  Decimal transactionProportionalFee,
  Decimal transactionFixedFee
)

Calculate the Stripe service fees for a given USD amount using the provided fees or the default fees if null

Parameters:
    amount – Decimal: amount in USD to calculate the service fees for
    transactionProportionalFee – Decimal: proportional fee to use for the calculation (if null then the default proportional fee is used)
    transactionFixedFee – Decimal: fixed fee to use for the calculation (if null then the default fixed fee is used)

Returns:
    [Decimal] Stripe fees in USD for the transaction
